name: Stormbringer: Windrunner raises run and mounted speed natively (#3154)
contract: #3154 reports 'Spell Script / Aura Handler Not Implemented' for Windrunner (707719), a plain two-effect self-buff with no classmask/target-spell dependency: effect0 is aura 31 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED and effect1 is aura 172 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MOUNTED_SPEED_NOT_STACK, both EffectBasePoints 14 + 1 = 15 (matches the tooltip's 15%). The issue's own audit tool labels effect0 'Unknown Aura (31)', but aura type 31 is one of the core's most common, universally-used speed auras, not an unresolved custom one. Both aura types are applied by the stock AuraEffect/Unit::UpdateSpeed pipeline used by every class and every mount/item speed buff, and neither is one of the parity contract's known core gaps (aura 290 misc/classmask, effect 192, aura 214). Learning the passive-flagged spell auto-applies both effects; run_speed_rate reads the live unmounted-speed effect directly, and aura_amount on effect 1 confirms the mounted-speed aura's stored value without requiring an actual mount.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
DISCRIMINATING: Windrunner raises run speed rate by 15% (aura 31, effect0)

DISCRIMINATING: Windrunner's mounted-speed aura (172, effect1) stores its DBC-calculated value of 14 (EffectBasePoints[1]=14, EffectDieSides[1]=0 -> no +1 roll, unlike effect0's EffectDieSides[0]=1 which does add 1) without requiring an active mount
